title: Aethereal Dimensions
tagline: Aethereal Dimensions is the meaningfulness layer for web3 assets.
description:
Aethereal Dimensions is the decentralized infrastructure to power real web3 gaming experiences. It will allow artists, creators, game designers and developers to unite forces into creating valuable game worlds thriving on rich lore.

Aeth.D is the meaningfulness layer for web3 assets, as we provide users with a comprehensive range of tools that will give them greater understanding of how resources from a game are generated and how are they used inside the game, allowing for NFT collectors to more accurately assess their potential value.
‍
Aeth.D envisions setting a trend on Metaverse game design while exploring the possibilities and dynamics of web3 gaming. Initial Metaverse Offerings and Initial Game Offerings will allow to accelerate the artistic and technical production pace of web3 game and Metaverse platforms by giving like-minded creators the power to enrich your universe with more fantastic content.
how_its_made: The project is a webapp built with React hooks, Next.js and Moralis framework. It allows to launch Genesis Collections, a novel concept that takes Initial Metaverse Offerings to the next level by adding more interesting functionalities than just minting, buying and selling NFTs. It uses NFT.storage to pin the NFT image files into decentralized storage. Users can also explore Genesis Collections to invest on. Images are fetched directly from IPFS.
